task.description: Root-cause diagnosis (diagnosis only, not the fix) of ISS-0515: PR #1029 (REQ-226)'s backend CI gate failed twice reproducibly (~53min each) with widespread cascading test failures (200+ tests/partition) consistent with parallel test_parallel.sh partitions racing on tenant_template.ex's advisory-lock-guarded template build. A same-day docs-only PR (#1032, branched from main WITHOUT REQ-226's migration) ran the identical CI gate cleanly in 6-7 minutes, confirming the race is specific to REQ-226's branch state, not general harness fragility. Read docs/issues/ISS-0515.yaml in full for the complete symptom description and ORCH's working hypothesis (Ecto's default 15s query timeout applied to the pg_advisory_lock wait in tenant_template.ex, tipped over threshold by REQ-226's one additional migration under CI's specific hardware). CONFIRM OR REFUTE this hypothesis with direct evidence (read the actual timeout config, the actual lock-wait code, and ideally reproduce/instrument), then hand off to CODE-DESIGNER/ELIXIR-DEV for the actual fix -- do not implement the fix yourself.
